summary: Iteration 3 comprehensive testing PASSED. Backend: 44/44 pytest tests green (22 new iteration-3 tests + 22 iteration-1 regression). Verified notifications CRUD (list/unread-count/mark-single/mark-all/delete + auto-notify on doc creation), quotation→invoice→receipt conversion chain with all field mappings (source_quotation_id/number, source_invoice_id, against_invoice, amount==total, status transitions to invoiced/paid), user management CRUD with is_active gate on login (deactivated login returns 403 with 'deactivated'), welcome + role-change notifications, expense review with remarks and category-aware notifications (rejected/approved) sent to employee, letterhead PDFs (all four types >400KB, %PDF header valid), and owner role privileges matching manager (works/quotations/expense approval). Frontend E2E on Expo web mobile viewport (390x844): 13/13 critical flows passed — login page redesign with all 5 testIDs + login-error, manager login + notif-bell + notif-badge, navigation to /notifications with notif-mark-all, User Management (create/toggle-deactivate visible for manager only), Documents tab → quotation detail with convert-to-invoice-btn + PDF download (SE-QT-2026-021.pdf downloaded, no base64/undefined errors), full conversion chain quotation→invoice→receipt with link-source-quotation and link-source-invoice back-links, employee correctly does NOT see more-users. React-Native deprecation warnings (resizeMode/pointerEvents/shadow*/useNativeDriver) still present from prior iterations — non-blocking, already reported. No new blocking issues.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_draw_letterhead` correctly registered on both onFirstPage and onLaterPages — every page of multi-page PDFs will carry the letterhead (line 1050).
notify_managers uses `role: {$in: ['manager','owner']}, is_active: {$ne: False}` — correctly excludes deactivated managers/owners (server.py:113).
register endpoint uses `exclude_user_id=actor['id']` so acting manager isn't self-notified — good. Welcome notif is sent to new user separately (server.py:458-459).
convert-to-invoice / convert-to-receipt endpoints correctly propagate source_* linkage and flip source doc status to invoiced/paid (server.py:617,679).
Login endpoint returns 403 with 'deactivated' message when is_active is False (server.py:431).
server.py is 1357 lines — approaching the 700-line ceiling from code review guidelines. Consider splitting into routers (auth, docs, expenses, notifications) in a follow-up refactor.
Frontend more.tsx correctly gates 'users' item behind `isMgr = role==='manager' || role==='owner'` (line 12,16) — verified in E2E.
doc-detail.tsx correctly conditionally renders convert buttons and source-link buttons based on doc.source_* fields.
seed_data_creation: Test-created data uses TEST_ prefix (customers, users, quotations, invoices, receipts, expenses). Test users are DELETEd in teardown where possible; a few TEST_ documents remain in DB from create-verify tests (harmless, distinguishable by prefix).

Login as deactivated user returns 403 with 'deactivated' substring. Owner role has manager privileges. All PDFs embed letterhead (>400KB). Documents tab is bottom-tab (tap by text 'Documents' at ~y=825 on 390-wide viewport). PDF download on web uses <a download> data-url — confirmed working (SE-QT-2026-021.pdf).
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. The only pytest failure during authoring (test_register_and_notif) was a test-side false negative: acting manager is intentionally excluded from the 'new user created' broadcast via exclude_user_id=actor['id']. The test was fixed to spin up a second owner-role user and assert THAT owner receives the notification when a subsequent registration is triggered. All 44 backend tests now green.
